$doc: Cipherfilm design tokens: the one source for web, Android and Mac. Edit here, then run `node design/tokens/build.mjs` (or `make tokens`). See DESIGN.md, 'Tokens'.

color.$doc: Every color role in light and dark. Dark is the same desk with the light off: ink becomes the ground, paper the writing, teal lifts. Chrome only; photos carry the color.

paper.use: page, top bar and sidebar ground

paper-deep.use: search field, tile placeholders, hover fills, read-only inputs, empty states

rule-strong.use: input and button borders, open-state borders

teal.use: the one accent: primary actions, links, focus, selection, progress

teal-ink.use: pressed/hover teal, current nav text, secondary-button text

teal-tint.use: current nav item, pills, avatar, empty-state disc

teal-over.use: a drop target under a dragged item

on-teal.use: text and icons on a teal fill

danger-ink.use: long warning text on the danger tint

dot.use: unchecked selection dot on a photo

stage.$doc: The photo viewer is black in both modes: these do not change with the theme.

on-stage.use: text and icons in the viewer

stage-muted.use: secondary text in the viewer (n of m)

stage-on.use: viewer toggle that is on, or pressed

badge.use: video/favorite disc on a photo tile

on-badge.use: icon in a tile badge, the check in a selection dot

serif.web: Georgia, "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", "Times New Roman", serif

sans.web: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

type.$doc: Roles, not sizes. Each platform keeps its own base (web 16 px, Android 16 sp, macOS 13 pt), so a role has a size per platform. Serif only for time and place.

page.use: page titles, album and person names as titles

brand.use: the name Cipherfilm next to the mark

heading.use: day headings, section heads in a page

name.use: album and person names in grids

micro.use: year scrubber, tab labels on phones

space.$doc: The 4-point rhythm. Use these steps; anything else needs a reason.

touch.use: minimum target on web (WCAG 2.5.5 and phones)

control-mac.use: button height on the Mac (pointer only)

field-mac.use: text field height on the Mac

icon-stroke.use: icon line width on the 24 grid

loader.use: the loading badge inline: in buttons and status rows (web and Android)

loader-medium.use: the loading badge in a corner over a photo: the Android viewer while a photo decrypts or a video buffers

loader-large.use: the loading badge on its own: first load of the library, albums, people, search (web and Android)

loader-mac.use: the loading badge inline on the Mac

loader-large-mac.use: the loading badge on its own on the Mac

elevation.$doc: Flat at rest. Only these two shadows exist.

menu.use: menus, context menu, drag tray, upload window, toasts

motion.$doc: Short and decelerating; nothing moves when reduced motion is asked for (the loading ring only fades in and out then).

fast.use: hover and press color changes, chevrons

turn.use: one turn of the loading ring, linear

seal.use: one sealing loop of the large loading badge: tiles pass over the mark, the shackle closes

breathe.use: one fade of the loading ring when reduced motion is asked for

contrast.$doc: Pairs the build checks in both modes, with the minimum WCAG ratio. The build fails below it.
